summary: DESIGN.md's newspaper never reached the build: the app is the kit's default brand on systemGroupedBackground with purple chips, green-and-red answers, SF Symbol heroes, a '10' on a gradient for an icon, and a win that reads '8 out of 10 / Come back tomorrow for ten more'.
fixes: Add AppBrand.swift from DESIGN.md's tokens, apply .brand() to RootView and OnboardingView, and replace all eleven systemGroupedBackground sites with .brandBackground()/.brandSurface() plus the paper grain and column rules

Rebuild the answer as the ink press: ruled boxes with mono A-D gutters, a spring-driven ink sweep, Haptics.rigid at 200ms, .pop/.miss tones, and the red stamp landing on Motion.bouncy - no green/red borders, no circle symbols

Replace TodayView.done with the edition printing: masthead, CountUp at brandDisplay(size: 112) with climbing .step tones, the tally printing square by square, a tiered headline stamp and newsprint confetti; delete the verdict() switch
Strip the pitch from TodayView:49, TodayView:144, RootView:93, Reminders:27 and onboarding page 2 - the paywall is the only place the promise appears
Render design/art/*.svg into the catalog and use all six (press, stamp, desk, spike, case) as heroes, and overwrite AppIcon's icon-1024.png with the drawn stamp icon instead of '10' on purple
Replace the three Scorecard stat tiles with one 96pt streak, a brass ribbon and a mono ledger line, and recolour the calendar to ink density with today circled in pencil
Wire Tones and SoundsToggle, swap ShareCard.text for a 1080x1350 ShareImage front page, and add a -demo flag plus qa.json moments so the answer and the win are actually filmed
